proposals.before: Zhang Yongde of Caozhou, imperial son-in-law and grand councilor, became Xuzhou commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State;
proposals.after: Zhang Yongde of Chanzhou, imperial son-in-law and grand councilor, became Xu prefecture commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State;
proposals.reason: Chinese has 澶州 and 許州; idiomatic English wrongly has Caozhou and confuses 許州 as Xuzhou.

proposals.before: Zhang Yongde, Caozhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Imperial Son-in-Law, was made Xuzhou military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
proposals.after: Zhang Yongde, Chanzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Imperial Son-in-Law, was made Xu prefecture military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
proposals.reason: Chinese has 澶州 and 許州; literal English wrongly has Caozhou and renders 許州 as Xuzhou.

proposals.before: Murong Yanzhao of Huainan, deputy director of the Palace Front, became Caozhou commissioner with acting Grand Tutor, kept his front-director post, and was made Earl Who Opens the State;
proposals.after: Murong Yanzhao of Huainan, deputy director of the Palace Front, became Chanzhou commissioner with acting Grand Tutor, kept his front-director post, and was made Earl Who Opens the State;
proposals.reason: Chinese has 澶州節度使; idiomatic English wrongly has Caozhou instead of Chanzhou.

proposals.before: Murong Yanzhao, Huainan military commissioner, Concurrent Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and acting Grand Guardian, was made Caozhou military commissioner and acting Grand Tutor, remaining Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and advanced to Earl Who Opens the State;
proposals.after: Murong Yanzhao, Huainan military commissioner, Concurrent Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and acting Grand Guardian, was made Chanzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Tutor, remaining Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and advanced to Earl Who Opens the State;
proposals.reason: Chinese has 澶州; literal English mistranslates as Caozhou.

proposals.before: That same day Li Fang, Humeng, and Zhao Feng, all drafters of imperial commands, were given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.
proposals.after: That same day Li Fang, Hu Meng, and Zhao Feng, all drafters of imperial commands, were given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.
proposals.reason: Chinese 扈蒙 is the personal name Hu Meng; idiomatic English fuses it as Humeng.

proposals.before: That day, Li Fang, Hanlin Academician, Secretariat Bureau Director of the Fields Section, and Drafter of Imperial Commands; Humeng, Bureau Director of the Capital Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands; and Zhao Feng, Bureau Director of the Waters Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands, were all given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.
proposals.after: That day, Li Fang, Hanlin Academician, Secretariat Bureau Director of the Fields Section, and Drafter of Imperial Commands; Hu Meng, Bureau Director of the Capital Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands; and Zhao Feng, Bureau Director of the Waters Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands, were all given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.
proposals.reason: Chinese 扈蒙 should be spaced as Hu Meng in English.

proposals.before: On yimao Xu Xiong, Remonstrance Censor of the Right, was stripped of three ranks for falsely accusing the magistrate of Leize of inflating household destruction figures.
proposals.after: On yimao Xu Xiong, Remonstrance Censor of the Right, was stripped of three ranks for falsely accusing the magistrate of Leize of falsely reporting reduced household registers.
proposals.reason: 虛破戶 means fraudulently reporting destroyed/reduced households, not inflating destruction figures.

proposals.before: On wuwu the Guangli Army of Yanzhou was abolished and restored to the Laowu directorate.
proposals.after: On wuwu the Guangli Army of Yanzhou was abolished and restored to the Laiwu directorate.
proposals.reason: 萊蕪 is Laiwu; idiomatic English misspells it as Laowu.

decisions.after: Zhang Yongde of Chanzhou, imperial son-in-law and grand councilor, became Xuzhou commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State;
decisions.reason: Focus unit has 澶州節度使…為許州節度使; Caozhou misreads 澶州 and must become Chanzhou, but Xuzhou remains the project’s normal romanization of 許州, so the proposed “Xu prefecture” rewrite is dropped.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 澶州節度使…為許州節度使

decisions.after: Zhang Yongde, Chanzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Imperial Son-in-Law, was made Xuzhou military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
decisions.reason: The literal likewise has 澶州 misread as Caozhou; Chanzhou is required, while 許州 is correctly kept as Xuzhou rather than the awkward “Xu prefecture military commissioner.”

sourceWitness.excerpt: 澶州節度使…為許州節度使

decisions.reason: Focus unit appoints Murong Yanzhao 為澶州節度使; Caozhou is a false reading of 澶州, and Chanzhou restores the correct prefecture.
The literal repeats the same 澶州→Caozhou error; replacing it with Chanzhou matches 為澶州節度使.
Focus unit names 扈蒙 beside 李昉 and 趙逢; Humeng wrongly fuses the surname and given name, and Hu Meng is the correct spaced English personal name.
The literal likewise writes Humeng for 扈蒙; spacing as Hu Meng correctly reflects the two-character personal name.

decisions.after: On yimao Xu Xiong, Remonstrance Censor of the Right, was stripped of three ranks for falsely accusing the magistrate of Leize of fraudulently reducing registered households.
decisions.reason: 虛破戶 means fraudulently reducing registered households, so “inflating household destruction figures” is wrong; the proposal’s “falsely reporting…” stacks a second “falsely” after “falsely accusing” and is awkward, so the idiomatic is revised to match the Chinese sense cleanly.
Focus unit restores 萊蕪監; Laowu misspells 萊蕪, and Laiwu is the correct place-name.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0005 shows Humeng existed only as a fused mistranslation of 扈蒙; the valid personal name is already claimed as Hu Meng in c0215.
